compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Five dated evidence/analysis files sit under `docs/` as if maintained: `docs/remediation-implementation-plan.md` (775 L), `docs/oss-comparison-and-remediation.md` (232 L), `docs/88ab-feature-branch-evidence.md` (225 L), `docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md` (115 L), `docs/dco-rollout-evidence.md` (83 L). Each is the durable copy of a ticket trail (`88ab…md:5-7` says so verbatim). Two 13-line stubs (`docs/writing-a-passing-plan.md`, `docs/passing-code-review.md`) exist only "so existing links do not break" — the only Markdown links to them are `docs/README.md:58,74`. Six citations name `docs/designs/sync-hardening-proposal.md`, which never existed.

## Approach
1. **Post before deleting.** For each of the five files, post ONE `comment_ticket` (MCP) on its target ticket whose first line is `Relocated from docs/<file> @ origin/main 083620b08116 by E11 S1 (<this story alias>)`, followed by the file body verbatim. Then `git rm` the five files.
2. Update the index and the prose mentions: `docs/README.md` delete lines 58, 74, 127, 128, 136, 138, 140 (keep 67 FP ledger, 137, 139; do not touch 130/142). `docs/archive/README.md:11` (replace "Superseded by the durable analysis in `../oss-comparison-and-remediation.md`" with "its analysis docs are preserved as comments on epic `hoary-datum-cop` (`0b32-bc94-5ea1-482a`)") and `:13` (rewrite: "The plans it pointed at were relocated to that epic's comments; nothing living remains here."). `docs/archive/2026-06-13-oss-comparison-session-log.md:15-17` table rows → the ticket pointer (line 17's stale `docs/2026-06-13-…` path → `docs/archive/…`). `infra/gerrit/feature-branch-e2e-scenarios.sh:348` comment → `# concurrency.group cancel-in-progress (story will-tile-plum 2e8a-1a3b-66bf-4cd1 AC5; evidence comment on epic elfish-chair-lug)`. The experiments README link (`docs/experiments/README.md:4` today; relocated by the eval-harness story — locate with `git grep -n 'remediation-implementation-plan' origin/main`) → "the remediation plan is preserved as a comment on epic `hoary-datum-cop` (`0b32-bc94-5ea1-482a`)" (plain text, no link). Frozen corpora under `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/runs/*.jsonl` are NOT edited.
3. Delete the stubs; nothing else links them (AGENTS.md:215,428 already cite `src/rebar/_guides/*.md` / `rebar explain plan|review`; `registry.py:665-666` and `criterion-pins.json` name the packaged basenames).
4. Tests: `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_docs_enumeration_parity.py` — delete the two `oss-comparison-and-remediation.md` arms (`:103-114`), `_COUNT_ARM` (`:123-129`), `_count_word`/`_NUMBER_WORDS` (`:26-36, :83-88`), `test_relation_count_matches_its_master` (`:163-170`); rewrite the module docstring to "two enumerations across two documents". `tests/unit/test_project_symbol_reference_completeness.py:208-215` — delete `test_real_review_run_evidence_is_committed` (its AC "repo-verifiable artifact, not only a ticket comment" is retired by the operator decision; record that in the ticket comment).
5. Phantom citations this epic owns: `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py:89-90` → "a hyphenated file name like `docs/plan-review-gate.md` must not accept a block (a phantom design-doc path masked a live raw SHA in the b047 close verification)"; `tests/unit/test_comment_hygiene_guard.py:168-170` docstring → same wording, `:175` fixture line → `"# docs/plan-review-gate.md section 3.\nX = 1\n"` (assertion `returncode == 1` unchanged); `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_differ_field_contract.py:88` → `"See story a130-2b7c-429c-43d1 and the CONTRACT block in inbound_differ.py; symmetry rules live in _field_contract.py."`.

## Scope
Delete: `docs/remediation-implementation-plan.md`, `docs/oss-comparison-and-remediation.md`, `docs/88ab-feature-branch-evidence.md`, `docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md`, `docs/dco-rollout-evidence.md`, `docs/writing-a-passing-plan.md`, `docs/passing-code-review.md`.
Edit: `docs/README.md`, `docs/archive/README.md`, `docs/archive/2026-06-13-oss-comparison-session-log.md`, the relocated experiments README, `infra/gerrit/feature-branch-e2e-scenarios.sh`, `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`, `tests/unit/test_comment_hygiene_guard.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_differ_field_contract.py`, `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_docs_enumeration_parity.py`, `tests/unit/test_project_symbol_reference_completeness.py`.
Out of scope: `docs/code-review-fp-ledger.md` (kept), `src/rebar/llm/code_review/fp_ledger.py`, the two reconciler `src` citations (reconciler epic), `docs/README.md:130,142`.

## Testing
`python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` (index membership + every relative link in `docs/`, `.github`, `.agents`, `infra/runbooks`, `src/rebar/_guides`, `templates`); `python scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`; `python scripts/check_dco_identity.py`; `pytest tests/unit/test_check_docs_index.py::test_current_repo_index_is_clean tests/interfaces/contracts/test_docs_enumeration_parity.py tests/unit/test_project_symbol_reference_completeness.py tests/unit/test_comment_hygiene_guard.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_differ_field_contract.py tests/unit/test_guides.py tests/unit/test_guide_criterion_pins.py`; `git grep -n 'sync-hardening-proposal' -- scripts tests` must be empty.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Five `rebar show <target> -o json` outputs each contain a comment whose first line starts `Relocated from docs/<file>` and whose body equals the deleted file (verify: `diff <(git show 083620b08116:docs/<file>) <(comment body minus header)` is empty).
- [ ] `git ls-files docs/` lists none of the seven deleted files; `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` exits 0.
- [ ] `git grep -n 'writing-a-passing-plan.md\|passing-code-review.md' -- docs/README.md` is empty; `git grep -n 'docs/designs/sync-hardening-proposal' -- scripts tests` is empty.
- [ ] `test_docs_enumeration_parity.py` collects exactly two parametrized cases (`pytest --collect-only -q`).
- [ ] `docs/README.md:130` and `:142` are byte-identical to the eval-harness story's landed version (`git diff <its merge sha> -- docs/README.md` touches no line it owns).
